events.text_en: When the reelers of Hỏa Ti Trấn bar the road for Xích Thành, Nguyên Chước Ly burns the town with them in it.
The Ashen Phoenix Canon is carried out of Xích Thành Môn's burning gate; the founder teaches it to his elders with its blood pyre sealed.

Ngô Thê Đồng raises the Fire Court on the ashes of Hỏa Ti Trấn and sends his inner gate down from the ridge; Nguyên Chước Ly dies that winter of the fire she had taken in, and the court is built over her pyre.
Tang Sơ Ti gives the last fire-silk of Hỏa Ti to the founder; he lays it as the Nest Array from the mouth of Chúc Dung Khẩu to the Fire Court, and vows no silk will be reeled at these vents again.
Lãnh Hương's plum-blossom riders charge Phượng Minh's lines at Cô Thành; a young disciple burns their first rider out of the saddle.
In the burning hall of Cô Thành, Nhiếp Tẫn Sa finds a red sword laid on the riders' ashes with a note in red ink; Lâu Liệt Hà hangs it in the Hall of Spoils and forbids its name.
Liên Khánh Dao plays past the seventh movement of her Shao Remnant Score and dies at the zither; its eighth string snaps.
Lâu Liệt Hà follows Ô Kình Hải down into the burning hold of Thôn Hải Môn and does not come up.
Hề Bính Hỏa takes Thủ Lôi Bảo after nine days and burns it with its keeper Tạ Thiết Trụ inside; the lightning stored in its walls kills him in the same fire, and his disciples carry him out.
Cố Dạ Lan of Thính Vũ kills Dụ Đan Huỳnh on Đan Sơn Mạch and carries off her fan.

When the Pivot's arrays close on Kỷ Vãn Tình's rear guard at the pass (N-thinh_vu-08), Hách Chu Lăng takes the Thính Vũ swordsman Chử Trì Âm alive; he refuses the Tower's ransom, and in 1160 becomes the palace's guest.
Hoa Triêu Dương moves the head's court, the treasury and the Hall of Spoils down to the Fire Court of Hỏa Ti; the ridge palace becomes the Wutong Court under Vu Ngô Đồng.
At the Wutong Court, Vu Ngô Đồng hands Quan Vũ Thanh the head's private terms, drafted by Trình Hi Quang: peace for a fifth of Kinh Lôi Mạch's yield. No reply comes.
The boat paid to carry the musician of Thiều Âm Thị away sails without him; Lộ Văn Khánh keeps him in the ruins of Kích Khánh Đường.
